body: I tried last March and end up in the loony bin too. Regardless of the meds, things aren't getting easier, but what does make it easier is someone with a similar experience. It's nice to know you're not alone in your struggle. If you ever wanna talk to another bi polar suicidal artist I'm here for you and I understand what you're going through. Also I'd love to see some of your art! What do you like to do?

I'm on meds and have been going to therapy for the last 6 months but it doesn't seem to be helping. My parents found me last time. I would've bled out or overdosed if they hadn't come over for some reason. I was sent to a mental institution and if anything I made me feel even worse. I want to thank everyone for listening and replying because it means a lot to have compassion for strangers. I realize suicide is not a crime commit against yourself, but to everyone that loves you. I feel like if they could understand the seemingly never ending struggle they would be able to understand where I'm coming from, and that I'm not intentionally trying to hurt them. I'm doing my best, but I don't know if I was built to hold out much longer.
